note: Both sets correctly capture the six material callouts from the Figure 2-6 legend and most of the CG/GC/NA/SC marker positions, but Set A contradicts itself: it gives CG x3 as both 0.1 m and 0.0 m and GC x3 as both 0.05 m and 0.0 m for the same Section 0.7 cross section, and its '70 % span' claim is paired with a quote (the figure title) that never states 70% span. Set B is internally consistent, ties the 70% span value to the caption quote 'Blade cross section at 70% span', and keeps the turbine/section conditions, with its main error being SC x2 = -0.2 m, which duplicates the GC position while the SC marker (black diamond) sits on the opposite side near x2 ≈ 0.1 m. Set A does add one fact B omits (NA x3 = 0.05 m), but its duplicated, mutually exclusive coordinate claims and unsupported quote outweigh that gain.
